note: The bound is the same Lipschitz estimate for the difference function G_N. [L] uses the Euclidean distance, which is at most the l1 distance of [M]'s display, so the Lean bound is mildly stronger.

snippet.text:
lemma localLip {K:Set (Points n)} (hk: K ⊆ NoHit C.S p n) (he:IsCompact K) :
    ∃ r B : ℝ, 0 < r ∧ 0 ≤ B ∧ ∀ᶠ N in atTop,∀ x y:Positions n,
      tag (C.S.a N) x∈K → dist (tag (C.S.a N) y) (tag (C.S.a N) x) ≤ r →
        dist (gKernel C v l N p y) (gKernel C v l N p x) ≤ B * dist (tag (C.S.a N) y) (tag (C.S.a N) x):=by

proof_context.conclusion: `localLip` bounds `dist (gKernel C v l N p y) (gKernel C v l N p x)` by B times the Euclidean distance of the tagged points, for tagged x in K and distance at most r, eventually in N.
